description: During Segment 3, llama-server was restarted with optimized performance parameters instead of the frozen R13 runtime configuration. Scientific parameters (parallel, ctx, temp, seed, model, max_tokens) were unchanged, but thread count and batch sizes differ from the frozen runtime identity.

index_terminology.completed_index_615: 615 clean frozen-runtime trajectories already existed when the deviation occurred
index_terminology.note: 0-based completed index 615 = 1-based trajectory ordinal 616. The first 615 trajectories (index 0-614) were produced under the frozen runtime.

preserved_artifacts.pre_quarantine_original: results_pre_quarantine_original.jsonl — the complete results file before any quarantined records were removed (643 records including 28 deviant)
preserved_artifacts.quarantined_results: results.jsonl in quarantine/ — the 28 deviant records extracted from the original
preserved_artifacts.quarantined_model_calls: model_calls.jsonl in quarantine/ — 168 model calls from deviant trajectories
preserved_artifacts.quarantined_mechanism_receipts: mechanism_receipts.jsonl in quarantine/ — 14 mechanism receipts from deviant trajectories
preserved_artifacts.quarantined_cognition_cost_receipts: cognition_cost_receipts.jsonl in quarantine/ — 28 cognition cost receipts from deviant trajectories

rerun_status: All 28 quarantined keys have been rerun under the restored frozen runtime and verified by r13_validate_runtime_replacements.py. Per-key verification: backend_identity matches, protocol_id matches, zero record leakage, zero duplicate replacements.
closure_invariants: set(quarantined_keys) <= set(accepted_keys) — every quarantined key has a frozen-runtime replacement
for key in quarantined_keys: accepted_runtime_sha[key] == FROZEN_RUNTIME_SHA
no quarantined record appears in raw_closed/
scientific_impact: Latency, throughput, token-rate, and cognition-cost statistics from the 28 deviant executions are excluded. Even if model actions happened to match, the deviant-runtime measurements cannot contribute to cost analysis. The 28 keys have been rerun under the frozen runtime with correct latency/cost measurements.
